card.name: Section numbers in label cross-references
card.fires_on: A single digit such as 5, 6, 8 or 2 that begins a section number, usually inside parentheses cross-referencing label sections. It also fires on list-style numerals before a suffix like nd or rd.

modes.label: Section cross-reference digit
modes.description: The leading digit of a section number like 5.3 or 8.6 in a parenthetical reference to Warnings, Adverse Reactions or Use in Specific Populations.

modes.label: Ordinal or table number
modes.description: A digit starting an ordinal or a numbered column or footnote, followed by text or units.
modes.example: 1st Open your arms wide to the side. <<2>>nd Move palms up and above the head

card.plain: It marks the first digit of a section number in a label's cross-reference, such as (5.3) or (6.1).
